title: Dynamic binding of the bacterial chaperone Trigger factor to translating ribosomes
authors: Tora Hävermark; Mikhail Metelev; Erik Lundin; Ivan L. Volkov; Magnus Johansson
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌伴侣蛋白TF与核糖体新生链复合物的动态结合，属于蛋白质-核糖体互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The bacterial chaperone Trigger factor (TF) binds to ribosome-nascent chain complexes (RNCs) and co-translationally aids the folding of proteins in bacteria. Decades of studies have given a broad, but often conflicting, description of the substrate specificity of TF, its RNC-binding dynamics, and competition with other RNC-binding factors, such as the Signal Recognition Particle (SRP). Previous RNC-binding kinetics experiments were conducted on stalled RNCs in reconstituted systems, and consequently, may not represent the interaction of TF with ribosomes translating mRNA in the cytoplasm of the cell. Here, we used single-particle tracking (SPT) to measure TF binding to actively translating ribosomes inside living Escherichia coli . In cells, TF displays two distinct binding modes — long (ca 1 s) target-specific RNC binding, and shorter (ca 50 ms) sampling of non-target RNCs. RNC binding events are interrupted only by transient excursions to a freely diffusing state (ca 40 ms). We also show that TF competes with SRP for RNC binding in vivo , and in doing so, tunes the binding selectivity of SRP.
abstract_zh: 细菌伴侣蛋白触发因子（Trigger factor, TF）与核糖体-新生链复合物（ribosome-nascent chain complexes, RNCs）结合，并在细菌中协同翻译地辅助蛋白质折叠。数十年的研究对TF的底物特异性、其与RNC的结合动力学以及与其他RNC结合因子（如信号识别颗粒（Signal Recognition Particle, SRP））的竞争提供了广泛但常常相互矛盾的描述。以往的RNC结合动力学实验是在重构系统中的停滞RNC上进行的，因此可能无法代表TF与细胞质中翻译mRNA的核糖体之间的相互作用。在此，我们使用单粒子追踪（single-particle tracking, SPT）来测量活体大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）内TF与活跃翻译核糖体的结合。在细胞中，TF表现出两种不同的结合模式——长时程（约1秒）靶标特异性RNC结合，以及较短时程（约50毫秒）对非靶标RNC的采样。RNC结合事件仅被短暂的自由扩散状态（约40毫秒）的瞬态逸出所中断。我们还表明，TF在体内与SRP竞争RNC结合，并在此过程中调节SRP的结合选择性。
